activity.notes: Canales Rosillo was not president of the Republic of the Rio Grande. The republic selected Jesús Cárdenas as president and appointed Canales secretary of war and commander-in-chief. ATLAS therefore records his actual military-government office rather than treating him as sovereign leader.

sources.title: Canales Rosillo, Antonio
sources.citation_text: The Texas State Historical Association states that in January 1840 Jesús Cárdenas was selected president while Antonio Canales was appointed secretary of war and commander in chief.

sources.title: Republic of the Rio Grande
sources.citation_text: TSHA lists Jesús de Cárdenas as president and Antonio Canales Rosillo as commander-in-chief of the republic's army.
